hero.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Security Policies
hero.subtitle: Give every person exactly the access their role requires — no more, no less — across your ERP and CRM. We design permission matrices, enforce data-level rules, and log every action so sensitive records stay protected and fully auditable.

deliver.name: Role & permission matrix
deliver.description: We map every job function to a clear set of permissions, so access reflects how your team actually works instead of a vague all-or-nothing login.

deliver.name: Record & field-level rules
deliver.description: We restrict access down to individual records and fields, so a salesperson sees only their own deals and finance figures stay hidden from those who don't need them.

deliver.name: Branch & team segmentation
deliver.description: For multi-branch operations, we scope data and screens per branch or department so each location works in its own space without seeing the others.

deliver.name: Approval & escalation workflows
deliver.description: We build rules that route high-risk actions — large discounts, refunds, credit limits — for sign-off before they take effect.

deliver.name: Authentication & login security
deliver.description: We harden how people sign in with two-factor authentication, session timeouts, and password policies that fit your risk level.

deliver.name: Audit trail & access reports
deliver.description: Every login, edit, export, and permission change is logged, giving you a tamper-evident record and ready-to-review access reports.

outcomes.label: Data stays protected
outcomes.description: Sensitive financials, payroll, and customer data are visible only to the roles that genuinely need them, shrinking the chance of internal leaks.

outcomes.label: Clean audit on demand
outcomes.description: When auditors or management ask who changed what, you have a complete, time-stamped trail instead of guesswork.

outcomes.label: Fewer costly mistakes
outcomes.description: Approval gates on discounts, refunds, and edits stop accidental or unauthorized changes before they hit your numbers.

outcomes.label: Faster, safer onboarding
outcomes.description: New hires get the right access on day one from a predefined role, and leavers are revoked instantly without breaking anything.

faqs.question: What exactly is role-based access control?
faqs.answer: RBAC means access is tied to a person's role rather than handed out individually. We define roles like sales rep, branch manager, or accountant once, attach the right permissions to each, and assign people to roles — so access stays consistent and easy to manage as your team grows.

faqs.question: Can one person see only their own customers and deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. We apply record-level rules so each user sees only the data they own or are assigned, while managers get a wider view. This keeps your pipeline and customer list private between team members without separate systems.

faqs.question: Does this work with our existing ERP or CRM?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. We configure the native permission engine of platforms like Odoo and layer our own rules and audit logging where needed. If you're on a custom system we built, RBAC is woven directly into the application.

faqs.question: Will we be able to manage roles ourselves later?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We hand over a documented permission map and train your admins to create roles, adjust rights, and onboard staff. You fully own the code, data, and documentation — there's no lock-in and no dependency on us to add a user.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Book a free consultation and we'll review your structure and show a demo preview of how access and audit trails would work for your team. The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp, and we work in both Arabic and English.
